title: The 1911 Mona Lisa Theft
hook: Who stole the Mona Lisa from the Louvre's walls?
headline: The Louvre's missing masterpiece

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: In August 1911, the world-famous Mona Lisa vanished from the Louvre's main gallery.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: Vincenzo Peruggia, an Italian handyman and former Louvre employee, hid the canvas in his coat.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: He slipped out through a service door on the same afternoon, unnoticed by staff.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: The theft stayed hidden until Peruggia was finally caught in Italy in December 1913.

end.line: What would you have done with a priceless smile?

description: Explore the daring 1911 theft of the Mona Lisa and its lingering mysteries.

facts.claim: The Theft of the Mona Lisa
